verdict.rationale: Notte documents a vault for encrypted credential storage and states that the LLM never sees the actual credentials during agent execution. Its docs include an agent login example, and it offers its own email and phone identities for 2FA. Missing for 10: explicit TOTP-secret storage or code generation in the vault, detailed documentation of how the agent handles 2FA challenges end-to-end, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
